entries.name: VANGUARD
entries.lore: THE STANDARD-ISSUE HULL EVERY COMMANDER STARTS IN.

entries.name: VANGUARD MK-II
entries.lore: FIELD-REFITTED WITH A FASTER BREECH.

entries.name: VANGUARD MK-III
entries.lore: TWIN AUTOLOADERS KEEP TWO SHELLS IN THE AIR.

entries.name: SIEGEBREAKER
entries.lore: THE APEX REFIT. STEEL MEANS NOTHING TO IT.

entries.name: CANNON
entries.lore: ONE BARREL, ONE JOB.
entries.effect: FIRES A SHELL THAT BREAKS BRICK.

entries.name: TWIN AUTOLOADER
entries.lore: TWO SHELLS LOADED, NO WAITING.

entries.name: AP ROUNDS
entries.lore: TUNGSTEN CORES FOR STUBBORN STEEL.

entries.name: HULL PLATING
entries.lore: EXTRA PLATES BOLTED OVER THE ENGINE DECK.

entries.name: SHIELD
entries.lore: A FLICKERING ENERGY FIELD FROM SALVAGED TECH.

entries.name: BASE DEFENCE
entries.lore: ENGINEERS POUR STEEL AROUND HQ IN SECONDS.
entries.effect: BASE WALLS TURN TO STEEL FOR A TIME.

entries.name: FREEZE
entries.lore: CRYO CHARGE. THE FRONT GOES SILENT.

entries.name: SPEED
entries.lore: OVERTUNED FUEL INJECTORS. HOLD ON.

entries.name: STAR
entries.lore: A FIELD PROMOTION FOR YOUR HULL.

entries.name: ZOOM OUT
entries.lore: SPOTTER BALLOON WITH A WIDE LENS.
entries.effect: PULLS THE CAMERA BACK TO SEE MORE FIELD.

entries.name: WIPEOUT
entries.lore: DANGER CLOSE. EVERYTHING BURNS.
entries.effect: DESTROYS ALL ENEMIES ON THE FIELD.

entries.name: EXTRA LIFE
entries.lore: A RESERVE CREW AND A SPARE HULL.

entries.name: SCOUT
entries.lore: FAST, LOUD, AND FIRST THROUGH THE BREACH.
entries.effect: HIGH SPEED, ONE HIT TO DESTROY.

entries.name: RAPID
entries.lore: ITS AUTOLOADER NEVER JAMS. UNFORTUNATELY.
entries.effect: FAST SHELLS, ONE HIT TO DESTROY.

entries.name: ARMORED
entries.lore: ROLLING SCRAP-PLATE. AIM FOR THE SEAMS.

entries.name: HEAVY
entries.lore: A FORTRESS THAT DECIDED TO DRIVE.
entries.effect: TAKES FOUR HITS. DROPS POWERUPS WHEN FLASHING.
